INSERT IGNORE INTO t_aged_app (hospcode,cid)
SELECT hospcode,cid FROM apps_ageing;

/**dental**/
UPDATE t_aged_app t INNER JOIN 
(
SELECT s.CID
,SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(DATE(s.datetime_serv) ORDER BY s.datetime_serv DESC),',',1) as DATE_SERV
,SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(s.PPSPECIAL ORDER BY s.datetime_serv DESC),',',1) as PPSPECIAL
FROM apps_ageing s
WHERE s.PPSPECIAL  IN('1B730','1B731') AND s.datetime_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
GROUP BY s.CID
)
s ON t.cid = s.cid 
SET t.dent_date = s.date_serv , t.dent_code= s.PPSPECIAL;

UPDATE t_aged_app SET result9=1
WHERE  date(eye_date) >0
AND  date(uria_date) >0  
AND  date(ear_date)>0 
AND  date(adl_date)>0 
AND  date(amt_date)>0 
AND  date(2q_date)>0 
AND  date(fall_date)>0 
AND  date(dent_date)>0 
AND  date(nutri_date)>0 ;

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_aged9_app','result6_3','int(9) DEFAULT 0');
